phase: Phase 4 Sky, Celestial Bodies, Atmosphere & Open-World Immersion
platform: Intel Iris Xe Graphics, Windows 11, Godot 4.6.3 Forward+ Vulkan

sky_system.clouds: Dual-deck animated cumulus + wispy cirrus, weather coverage coupling
sky_system.fog: Single-owner Rayleigh fog, unified diurnal & weather depth begin/end
sky_system.moon: Orbital counter-trajectory, procedural lunar maria/craters, terminator phase angle, earthshine
sky_system.scattering: Rayleigh + Mie gradient shader on 820m celestial dome sphere
sky_system.stars: 3D spherical Voronoi starfield (zero zenith distortion), twinkle animation, tilted Milky Way band
sky_system.sun: 3D astronomical arc, limb darkening, corona, horizon refraction
